records.cause: A maritime industry executive attributed delays to limited customs operating hours and the absence of a full-time customs presence.
records.reported_effect: The executive reported that documentation processes could take 8 to 10 hours and that vessels sometimes waited for clearance, affecting sailing schedules and increasing costs.

source.licence_notes: Licence and redistribution terms not verified; only a concise attributed factual summary and link are retained.

limitations: The report attributes the claims to an industry executive; it does not independently verify them.
The 8-to-10-hour figure is a reported documentation processing duration, not a measured excess delay.
The start and end dates of the condition are not stated; the publication date is not an event date.
The report does not identify any case-study supplier or establish that a specific shipment was affected.
No graph entity or shipment match has been reviewed.
